records.groupTitle: Proportion Of Adults Aged 16 - 65 Achieving At Least A Fixed Level Of Proficiency In Literacy Skills And Numeracy Skills By Sex
records.title: Proportion Of Adults Aged 16 - 65 Achieving At Least A Fixed Level Of Proficiency In Literacy Skills And Numeracy Skills By Sex
records.dataSource: ORGANISATION FOR ECONOMIC CO-OPERATION AND DEVELOPMENT
records.footnote: Data were taken from Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)'s Programme for the International Assessment of Adult Competencies (PIAAC), targeting adults aged 16 - 65. Data are used for SDG 4.6.1 'Proportion of population in a given age group achieving at least a fixed level of proficiency in functional (a) literacy and (b) numeracy skills, by sex'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 4.6.1.
